insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Individual/Family Floater: 5L to 3Cr (by plan). Family First: Base individual SI 1L to 15L + floater SI as per formula (by plan).

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: Re-fill benefit Reinstate up to base Sum Insured. Applicable for same & different illness as well
great.reference: Annexure II – Product Benefit Table; also Section 3.13 Re-fill Benefit
great.explanation: Reinstates up to the base Sum Insured and can be used for both same and different illnesses. This helps you get additional coverage in the same policy year after the base Sum Insured is used.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
great.quote: We will pay above mentioned Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for period up to 90 days immediately preceding the Insured Person’s admission
great.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for up to 90 days immediately before hospitalization. This reduces out-of-pocket costs for tests, consultations, and medicines leading up to admission.

great.name: Specific Illness Waiting Period
great.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 12 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
great.explanation: Listed specified diseases/procedures are not covered for the first 12 months from the first policy start date. This is better than many plans that impose a 24-month waiting period for such conditions.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a Pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 24 months of continuous coverage from the first policy inception. This is a standard-to-good PED waiting period versus many policies that require 36 months.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered in the first 30 days from policy commencement, except accidents. This is a common market-standard waiting period.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: We will pay Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for up to 180 days immediately following the Insured Person’s discharge
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for up to 180 days after discharge. This helps pay for follow-up consultations, diagnostics, and medicines during recovery.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: We will indemnify on Reimbursement basis only, the Medical Expenses incurred for the Insured Person’s Domiciliary Hospitalization during the Policy Period
good.explanation: Pays eligible domiciliary hospitalization expenses on a reimbursement basis during the policy period. This can help when hospital admission is not possible and treatment is taken at home (subject to policy conditions).

good.name: Modern Treatments
good.quote: Modern Treatments Covered up to Sum Insured with sub-limit of Rs. 1Lac on few robotic surgeries
good.reference: Annexure II – Product Benefit Table; also Section 3.25 (Modern Treatments) special condition
good.explanation: Modern treatments are covered up to the Sum Insured, but some robotic surgeries are capped at ₹1 lakh. This provides coverage for advanced procedures but may leave a gap for high-cost robotic surgeries.

good.name: No Claim Bonus
good.quote: We will provide Loyalty Additions in the form of Cumulative Bonus by increasing the Sum Insured applicable under the Policy by 10% of the Base Sum Insured of the immediately preceding Policy Year subject to a maximum of 100% of the Base Sum Insured.
good.explanation: Increases Sum Insured by 10% of the Base Sum Insured each claim-free year, up to 100% maximum. This can grow your coverage over time if you do not make claims.

good.name: No Claim Bonus
good.quote: Loyalty Additions ... automatically increase to 20% of Base Insured and the maximum Loyalty Additions shall not exceed 200% of the Base Sum Insured.
good.explanation: An enhanced option increases the bonus accrual to 20% and raises the maximum bonus cap to 200% of Base Sum Insured. This can significantly boost your available cover over time if you choose this option.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: Room rent Option 1: Rs 3,000 per day or Shared Room; whichever is lower Option 2: Rs 5,000 per day or Single Private Room; whichever is lower
bad.reference: Annexure II – Product Benefit Table (Family First variant – Silver)
bad.explanation: Room rent is capped at ₹3,000/day (shared) or ₹5,000/day (single private), whichever is lower as per the option. Choosing a higher-priced room can trigger reduced claim payouts and higher out-of-pocket costs.

bad.name: Proportionate Deduction
bad.quote: If the Insured Person is admitted in a Hospital room where the room category opted or Room Rent incurred is higher than the eligibility as specified in the Policy Schedule, then We shall be liable to pay only a pro-rated portion of the total Associated Medical Expenses ...
bad.explanation: If you take a room above your eligible category/limit, the insurer pays only a pro-rated portion of associated medical expenses. This can sharply reduce the payout not just for room rent but also for doctor, surgery, and other linked hospital bills.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Annexure VII - The expenses that are not covered ... List  I – Expenses not covered ... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ... 57 NEBULISATION KIT ... 58 ANY KIT WITH NO DETAILS MENTIONED [DELIVERY KIT, ORTHOKIT, RECOVERY KIT, ETC]
bad.reference: Annexure VII – The expenses that are not covered or subsumed into room charges / procedure charges / costs of treatment
bad.explanation: Common consumables like gloves, masks, nebulisation kits, and various procedure kits are listed as not covered/subsumed. This typically increases out-of-pocket spending during hospitalization.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: If You select Zone 2, then 20% Co-payment will apply for treatment in Mumbai (including Navi Mumbai & Thane), Delhi NCR, Kolkata & Gujarat State.
bad.explanation: If Zone 2 is selected, a 20% co-payment applies for treatment in Mumbai (including Navi Mumbai & Thane), Delhi NCR, Kolkata and Gujarat. This means you will pay 20% of the admissible claim amount in these locations.

bad.name: Disease Sub-limits
bad.quote: HIV / AIDS covered up to Rs 50,000 ... Mental disorder treatment ... (sub-limit of Rs 50,000 applicable on few conditions) ... Modern Treatments ... sub-limit of Rs. 1Lac on few robotic surgeries
bad.reference: Annexure II – Product Benefit Table; Section 3.17; Section 3.19; Section 3.25
bad.explanation: Certain conditions/treatments have rupee caps such as HIV/AIDS up to ₹50,000, mental disorder treatment sub-limits of ₹50,000 for some conditions, and ₹1 lakh for a few robotic surgeries. These caps can leave you paying the balance even when you have sufficient Sum Insured.

unclear.name: Cashless Network
unclear.quote: Cashless Facility can be availed only at Our Network Providers or Service Providers (as applicable). The complete list of Network Providers is available on Our website
unclear.explanation: Cashless treatment is available only at the insurer’s network/service providers, with the list hosted on the website. The policy does not state the number of network hospitals, so you should verify availability in your city before buying.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
